top15.name: Credo Technology Group
top15.why: Exceptional growth acceleration, strong profitability and margins, and direct exposure to rapidly expanding AI data-center connectivity demand.
top15.risk: Customer concentration, valuation, or a sharp slowdown in AI networking demand could weaken the case.

top15.name: Astera Labs
top15.why: Rapid revenue acceleration, high-margin connectivity products, and expanding demand around AI infrastructure create one of the strongest current growth fingerprints.
top15.risk: The case depends heavily on sustained AI infrastructure spending and successful expansion beyond a concentrated set of large customers.

top15.name: Reddit
top15.why: Strong revenue growth, expanding profitability and cash generation, growing user activity, and multiple monetization paths support the developing platform fingerprint.
top15.risk: Advertising cyclicality, user-growth deceleration, competition, or weaker monetization could compress the case quickly.

top15.name: Celestica
top15.why: Accelerating revenue, improving earnings power, and growing exposure to AI and advanced data-center infrastructure are strengthening the evidence.
top15.risk: Hardware-cycle volatility, customer concentration, and margin pressure could reduce the quality of the growth.

top15.name: Samsara
top15.why: Large and expanding recurring revenue, strong enterprise adoption, improving profitability, and a broad physical-operations software opportunity resemble an early platform leader.
top15.risk: Premium valuation, competitive pressure, or slowing large-customer growth would weaken the fingerprint.

top15.name: Rubrik
top15.why: Strong subscription growth, improving cash generation, and cybersecurity demand create a scalable recurring-revenue case with improving business quality.
top15.risk: Competition, slower subscription expansion, or failure to sustain operating leverage could lower the rating.

top15.name: Natera
top15.why: Rapid testing-volume expansion, rising revenue, improving margins, and increasing adoption in oncology and genetic testing create a powerful healthcare growth fingerprint.
top15.risk: Reimbursement, regulatory, litigation, or clinical-adoption setbacks could materially damage the case.

top15.name: Rocket Lab
top15.why: Fast revenue growth, a large backlog, increasing launch activity, and expansion into space systems give the company unusually large upside optionality.
top15.risk: It remains loss-making, requires heavy capital, and execution of Neutron is a major make-or-break dependency.

top15.name: CAVA Group
top15.why: Strong unit expansion, positive traffic, healthy same-store growth, and improving restaurant economics create a consumer-growth fingerprint similar to early category leaders.
top15.risk: Restaurant expansion can destroy returns if new-unit economics weaken, traffic slows, or food and labor costs rise materially.

top15.name: Nu Holdings
top15.why: Massive customer growth, strong profitability, high returns on equity, and continued expansion across Latin America support a scalable financial-platform case.
top15.risk: Credit quality, regulation, foreign-exchange exposure, and slower customer monetization are the principal threats.

top15.name: Robinhood Markets
top15.why: Platform assets, funded customers and transaction activity continue expanding while the company broadens beyond trading into a larger financial-services ecosystem.
top15.risk: Revenue remains exposed to market activity, regulation and crypto/trading cycles; enthusiasm can reverse quickly in weak markets.

top15.name: Tempus AI
top15.why: Rapid growth in diagnostics, data applications and molecular testing gives Tempus a differentiated healthcare-data and AI adoption story.
top15.risk: Profitability is still developing and the case depends on successful commercialization, reimbursement and continued clinical adoption.

top15.name: SharkNinja
top15.why: Strong product innovation, category expansion, international opportunity and continued sales growth suggest a durable consumer-brand compounder rather than a one-product story.
top15.risk: Consumer demand can cool quickly and copycat competition, tariffs, channel inventory or failed product launches could hurt the case.

top15.name: IREN Limited
top15.why: Explosive AI-cloud demand, large contracted capacity ambitions and substantial infrastructure expansion create a very high-upside growth profile.
top15.risk: Capital intensity, financing needs, execution risk, customer concentration and infrastructure buildout make this one of the riskiest candidates on the board.

top15.name: Nebius Group
top15.why: Very rapid AI-infrastructure growth, major customer commitments and aggressive capacity expansion give Nebius a potentially enormous runway.
top15.risk: The required capital is huge, profitability is immature, execution is demanding and the company is exposed to a highly competitive AI infrastructure market.

rising.name: SoFi Technologies
rising.why: Strong member growth, improving profitability and expanding financial-services revenue keep the case advancing.
rising.risk: Credit performance and funding conditions remain important risks.
rising.next: Sustained earnings growth, durable credit quality and stronger evidence that multiple business lines are compounding together.

rising.name: Toast
rising.why: Restaurant-location growth, recurring revenue and improving profitability support a strong vertical-software platform case.
rising.risk: Restaurant industry weakness or slower location growth could flatten the trajectory.
rising.next: More operating leverage, stronger enterprise penetration and continued recurring-revenue acceleration.

rising.name: Dutch Bros
rising.why: Strong unit growth and healthy consumer demand create an early national-brand expansion fingerprint.
rising.risk: New-store economics and same-store traffic must remain healthy during rapid expansion.
rising.next: Another period of strong traffic, successful openings and sustained margins.

rising.name: CoreWeave
rising.why: Massive AI infrastructure demand and backlog create extraordinary growth potential.
rising.risk: Very large losses, debt and capital requirements make the current financial risk unusually high.
rising.next: Clear evidence of improving unit economics, cash generation and manageable financing requirements.

rising.name: Lumentum
rising.why: AI data-center optical demand is driving unusually strong growth and margin improvement.
rising.risk: Optical cycles can reverse quickly and customer concentration remains meaningful.
rising.next: Confirmation that current acceleration persists beyond a single demand cycle.

rising.name: Coherent
rising.why: AI-related optical communications demand and improving earnings are strengthening the case.
rising.risk: The business remains cyclical and requires continued margin improvement.
rising.next: Sustained growth, stronger free cash flow and evidence that AI demand is structurally durable.

rising.name: Dave
rising.why: Rapid revenue and profit growth create a compelling small-cap fintech growth fingerprint.
rising.risk: Regulatory and litigation exposure around lending products is substantial.
rising.next: Continued growth with reduced regulatory uncertainty and durable credit performance.

rising.name: Nextpower
rising.why: Large backlog, growing solar and power-system demand, and new-product expansion support a scalable infrastructure story.
rising.risk: Project timing, policy changes and solar-industry cyclicality can cause sharp swings.
rising.next: Continued backlog conversion, margin durability and evidence that newer products broaden the growth engine.

rising.name: Affirm
rising.why: Large consumer and merchant networks plus expanding transaction volume support a broad payment-network opportunity.
rising.risk: Credit losses, funding costs and regulation remain central to the case.
rising.next: More consistent profitability and proof that growth remains strong through a less favorable credit environment.

watchlist.name: monday.com
watchlist.why: The business remains high quality with recurring software revenue and solid profitability.
watchlist.risk: Growth has moderated enough that the fingerprint is less explosive than the leading candidates.
watchlist.next: Reacceleration in enterprise demand or growth without sacrificing margins.

watchlist.name: Duolingo
watchlist.why: User engagement and brand strength remain exceptional.
watchlist.risk: Revenue growth has slowed and forward expectations need to improve.
watchlist.next: Renewed revenue acceleration and evidence that monetization can keep pace with user growth.

watchlist.name: Hims & Hers Health
watchlist.why: The company previously showed exceptional consumer-health growth and brand momentum.
watchlist.risk: Recent growth, margin and profitability deterioration materially weakened the fingerprint.
watchlist.next: A clean reacceleration in revenue, margins and profitability before promotion is justified.

watchlist.name: e.l.f. Beauty
watchlist.why: Brand strength, innovation and strong recent sales growth remain attractive.
watchlist.risk: Forward growth expectations have slowed while debt and acquisition complexity increased.
watchlist.next: Evidence that acquisitions can sustain growth without damaging profitability or balance-sheet quality.

watchlist.name: TransMedics
watchlist.why: A differentiated organ-transplant platform and growing adoption create a compelling long-term story.
watchlist.risk: The freshest evidence needs deeper review before promotion.
watchlist.next: Verified acceleration in procedure volume, revenue and operating leverage.

watchlist.name: PROCEPT BioRobotics
watchlist.why: Robotic surgical adoption gives the company an attractive medical-technology opportunity.
watchlist.risk: Recent execution and inventory concerns weakened confidence.
watchlist.next: Restored execution, cleaner inventory trends and stronger guidance.

watchlist.name: Sezzle
watchlist.why: The company has shown rapid growth and profitability in buy-now-pay-later.
watchlist.risk: Recent forward expectations and price reaction suggest the growth case needs reconstruction.
watchlist.next: Improved guidance and evidence that growth remains durable without rising credit risk.

watchlist.name: AST SpaceMobile
watchlist.why: Direct-to-device satellite broadband has an enormous addressable market if execution succeeds.
watchlist.risk: The business remains highly dependent on deployment, funding, regulation and technical execution.
watchlist.next: More operating satellites, commercial service evidence and clearer economics.
